> 第21章 全还给你（第1页）
柳大春一闻味儿，就感觉怪怪的，但为了钱，也是没法子，刚要喝呢，被师娘给拦住了，打掉了碗。
后来师娘说，要喝这东西，师娘也有，还不用碗盛。
柳大春现在变不傻了，回想起来，才知道那是什么。
原来那赵妤芳去玉米地里撒了泡尿。
不过赵家三闺女都是极品美人，那提亲的门槛都被人踩烂了，哪怕是赵妤芳她妈，村里多少男人做梦都想和她偷呢。
不过赵妤芳他妈还是很自恃其高的。
“傻子，你这是干嘛呢？？”赵妤芳看见傻子就想抓弄他，每次都能成功。
“运酒到镇上卖呢。”柳大春回答道。
“啊？卖酒？这什么酒啊？？”赵妤芳好奇地停下电瓶车问道。
“黄酒，埋在地下很多年了，挖出来卖。”柳大春很老实的回答，知道这傻女人又要玩弄自己，自己就继续装傻。
“哦，老黄酒啊，这老黄酒是好酒，但是呢，你知道老黄酒的精萃吗？？”赵妤芳故意问道。
“啥意思啊？？啥是精萃？”柳大春慢慢踩着三轮车问道。
“不懂了吧？这老黄酒需要往里面倒入一点特殊的东西，就会醇香无比，价值连城。”赵妤芳很认真地说道。
“当然是真的，你是傻子不知道正常。我跟你说，加了这液体啊，你的这酒啊，起码几百块钱一斤，你这么几大坛子至少可以卖五六万呢。”赵妤芳很认真地说道。
柳大春一听贵了那么多，便好奇地问：“那是什么东西啊？？”
“这是秘密，不能跟你说的，不过我能给你。”赵妤芳说道。
“那你快给我，我可以买。”柳大春说道。
“看在老乡的份上，我免费给你，你有瓢吗？？”赵妤芳问道。

柳大春把瓢拿了出来，递给了赵妤芳。
“傻子，你等着我，我给你精粹，不过你不能偷看哦，这是秘密哦。”赵妤芳说着，拉起了旁边的姐妹，使了个眼色，便往旁边的玉米地走去。
柳大春看着两个身影进了玉米地，冷笑道：“又要陷害我？想毁了我的酒？真是恶毒，看我怎么以牙还牙。”
柳大春走到电瓶车面前，看了看，前面的篮子里有一个水杯。
柳大春拿起水杯，打开来，里面还有一半热乎乎的凉茶。
“哼，以前你让我喝，我现在也让你喝喝看。”
柳大春说着，看了看那玉米地，那赵妤芳没见人影，就给她加了点东西，然后才把不锈钢的茶杯盖上，放回了原处。
那赵妤芳进入了玉米地，也开始使坏起来。
“赵妤芳，你这样会毁了那傻子的酒的。”闺蜜赵小小很担忧地说道。
“就是要毁了他的酒才好玩呢，好好戏弄这傻子。”赵妤芳坏坏地说道。
“赵妤芳，你这太坏了，傻大春已经够可怜了，无父无母，跟着师娘，师父还死了，只怕是村里最穷的人家了，那些老光棍还经常去欺负，咱们也欺负，不好吧？”闺蜜赵小小心地还是善良的，便说道。
“赵小小，你什么时候变圣母了？你要这么心疼他，你给那傻子当媳妇去呗！”赵妤芳反驳道。
很快两个人从玉米地里出来，赵妤芳把水瓢递给了柳大春道：“傻春，快点，拿着，千万别倒了，往酒坛子里倒，马上就不一样了。”
“好嘞。”柳大春接过水瓢，知道这是什么东西，刚接过水瓢，便故意脚下一滑，往赵妤芳扑了过去，顺势水瓢往赵妤芳的脸上迎面泼了过去。
那水瓢里的“水”不偏不倚，全部都泼在了赵妤芳的脸上，柳大春自己也特意摔倒在了地上。

> Chapter 21 Give it all back to you (Page 1)
Liu Dachun felt something strange as soon as he smelled the taste, but for the sake of money, he had no choice but to drink. When he was about to drink, the mistress stopped him and knocked the bowl away.
Later, the master's wife said that if you want to drink this thing, the master's wife also has it, and you don't need a bowl to serve it.
Liu Dachun is no longer stupid now. Looking back, he realizes what it was.
It turned out that Zhao Yufang went to the cornfield to urinate.
However, the three daughters of the Zhao family are all extremely beauties, and the threshold for marriage proposals has been trampled to pieces. Even Zhao Yufang's mother, many men in the village would dream of stealing from her.
But Zhao Yufang is still very proud of herself.
"Fool, what are you doing??" Zhao Yufang wanted to catch the fool when she saw him, but she succeeded every time.
"I'm transporting wine to the town to sell." Liu Dachun replied.
"Ah? Selling wine? What kind of wine is this??" Zhao Yufang stopped the battery car curiously and asked.
"Yellow wine has been buried in the ground for many years. Dig it out and sell it." Liu Dachun answered honestly. Knowing that this stupid woman was going to play with him again, he continued to act stupid.
"Oh, old yellow rice wine, this old yellow rice wine is good wine, but do you know the essence of old yellow rice wine?" Zhao Yufang asked deliberately.
"What do you mean? What is the essence?" Liu Dachun asked as he slowly stepped on the tricycle.
"Don't you understand? This old yellow rice wine needs to be poured into something special, and it will become extremely mellow and priceless." Zhao Yufang said seriously.
"Of course it's true. You're a fool and don't know what's normal. Let me tell you, after adding this liquid, your wine costs at least several hundred yuan per catty. A few jars like yours can sell for at least 50,000 to 60,000 yuan." Zhao Yufang said seriously.
When Liu Dachun heard that it was so expensive, he asked curiously: "What is that?"
"This is a secret. I can't tell you, but I can give it to you." Zhao Yufang said.
"Then give it to me quickly, I can buy it." Liu Dachun said.
"For the sake of my fellow countrymen, I will give it to you for free. Do you have a scoop?" Zhao Yufang asked.
Liu Dachun took out the ladle and handed it to Zhao Yufang.
"Idiot, wait for me, I'll give you the essence, but you can't peek, it's a secret." Zhao Yufang said, pulling up the sister next to her, winking, and walking to the cornfield next to her.
Liu Dachun watched the two figures enter the cornfield and sneered: "You want to frame me again? Want to ruin my wine? It's really vicious, let's see how I retaliate."
Liu Dachun walked to the battery car and looked at it. There was a water cup in the basket in front.
Liu Dachun picked up the water cup and opened it. There was still half of the hot herbal tea in it.
"Hmph, you let me drink it before, and I'll let you drink it now too."
As Liu Dachun spoke, he looked at the cornfield. Zhao Yufang saw no one there, so he added something to her, then covered the stainless steel tea cup and put it back in its place.
Then Zhao Yufang entered the cornfield and started to do mischief.
"Zhao Yufang, you will ruin that fool's wine." Best friend Zhao Xiaoxiao said worriedly.
"It's just fun to ruin his drink and make fun of this fool." Zhao Yufang said mischievously.
"Zhao Yufang, you are so bad. Silly Dachun is already pitiful. He has no father and no mother, and he follows his wife. The master is dead. I am afraid that he is the poorest family in the village. Those old bachelors often bully him, so we should bully him too, okay?" said her best friend Zhao Xiaoqing, who was still kind-hearted.
"Zhao Xiaoxiao, when did you become the Holy Mother? If you feel sorry for him so much, just become that fool's wife!" Zhao Yufang retorted.
Soon the two people came out of the cornfield. Zhao Yufang handed the water ladle to Liu Dachun and said: "Shachun, hurry up, take it, don't pour it, pour it into the wine jar, it will be different soon.""
"Okay. Liu Dachun took the water ladle and knew what it was. As soon as he took the water ladle, he deliberately slipped his foot and rushed towards Zhao Yufang. Taking advantage of the situation, Liu Dachun splashed the water on Zhao Yufang's face.
The "water" in the ladle was poured onto Zhao Yufang's face without any bias, and Liu Dachun himself fell to the ground on purpose.
